events.text:
La hipoxia reprograma la expresión génica de forma específica de cada tejido. En cordero se pierde el programa adiposo marrón tras el nacimiento, en adenocarcinoma pulmonar SATB2 potencia la respuesta a hipoxia y la resistencia terapéutica, y en carcinoma de cabeza y cuello STC2 define un endotelio angiogénico e inmunosupresor. Los modelos no son directamente comparables.

Síntesis inicial basada en resúmenes recuperados; la verificación detallada sigue en curso.

claims.text: Considere que la expresión de ARNm de SATB2 se induce marcadamente por hipoxia en líneas LUAD.
claims.quote: RT-qPCR analysis showed that SATB2 mRNA expression was markedly induced by hypoxia across these LUAD cell lines ( Fig. 1A ).

claims.text: Considere normoxia 20% O₂ frente a hipoxia 1% O₂ durante 24 h en líneas LUAD.
claims.quote: cultured under normoxic conditions (20% O₂) or hypoxic conditions (1% O₂) for 24 h.

claims.text: Considere el panel humano LUAD A549, H1299, H1975, NCI-H23, H1650 y Calu-3.
claims.quote: we first examined SATB2 expression in a panel of human LUAD cell lines, including A549, H1299, H1975, NCI-H23, H1650, and Calu-3,

claims.text: Para medir expresión considere RT-qPCR para ARNm SATB2 y western blot para proteína.
claims.quote: RT-qPCR analysis showed that SATB2 mRNA expression was markedly induced by hypoxia across these LUAD cell lines ( Fig. 1A ). Consistently, western blot analysis revealed increased SATB2 protein levels

claims.text: Considere que deleción de SATB2 reduce inducción hipóxica de VEGFA, EPO y LOX en A549.
claims.quote: RT-qPCR further showed that SATB2 knockout markedly impaired the hypoxia-induced expression of the representative HIF target genes VEGFA, EPO, and LOX in A549 cells

claims.text: Considere exposición a 20% o 1% O₂ durante 36 horas en células A549.
claims.quote: The control and HKO A549 cells were exposed to 20% or 1% O₂ for 36 hours, respectively.

claims.text: Considere que el ARNm de DIO2 disminuyó en ambos grupos LTH frente a control sin diferencias entre ellos.
claims.quote: DIO2 mRNA was significantly lower in both LTH-SL and LTH-HA compared to control ( Figure 3(a )); no differences were observed between LTH-SL and LTH-HA for DIO2.

claims.text: Considere que la expresión génica se midió como concentración de ARNm en fg por 50 ng de ARN total.
claims.quote: Messenger RNA concentrations (fg mRNA per 50 ng total RNA) for Uncoupling Protein 1 (UCP1) (a) and leptin (b) in perirenal fat from 14-day old control (CONT) lambs

claims.text: Considere hipoxia gestacional moderada prolongada in utero con mantenimiento posnatal en altura o nivel del mar hasta 14 días.
claims.quote: 14-day old lambs exposed to long term moderate gestational hypoxia in utero (LTH) then maintained post-birth at either high altitude (HA) or near sea level (SL) through 14 days’ post-birth.

claims.text: Considere que el sistema estudiado fue adiposo perirrenal de corderos control, LTH-SL y LTH-HA.
claims.quote: We had perirenal adipose available for 3 lambs per treatment group (3 control, 3 LTH-SL, and 3 LTH-HA).

claims.text: Considere que en corderos LTH a ~14 días posnatales UCP-1 y PGC1α disminuyeron significativamente, nazcan a gran altitud o a nivel del mar.
claims.quote: in the present study, at ~14 days post-birth both UCP-1 and a critical gene that governs the BAT/beige phenotype (PGC1α) were significantly decreased in the LTH lambs regardless of whether they were born at high altitude or at near sea level.

claims.text: Considere que PPARγ aumentó significativamente en PRF de corderos LTH nacidos a nivel del mar, pero no a gran altitud.
claims.quote: Interestingly, PPARγ was significantly upregulated in PRF of LTH lambs born at sea level but not at high altitude.

claims.text: Considere que la expresión de DIO2 en PRF al día 14 fue significativamente menor en corderos LTH de gran altitud y de nivel del mar.
claims.quote: In the day 14 lambs, DIO2 expression was significantly lower in the PRF of both LTH lambs born at high altitude and those born at sea level.

claims.text: Considere que el ARNm de UCP-1 siguió detectable en PRF, pero la proteína fue indetectable por Western aun con carga máxima.
claims.quote: While mRNA for UCP-1 was still detectable in control and LTH PRF, protein levels were below the ability to detect using Western analysis despite loading maximal amounts of cytoplasmic protein.

claims.text: Considere que se compararon corderos LTH nacidos y mantenidos a gran altitud con hipoxia leve continua frente a nivel del mar normóxico dos semanas.
claims.quote: Additionally, we compared LTH lambs born and maintained at high altitude for the first two weeks of life (continued mild hypoxia) to those born at sea level and maintained for the first two weeks of life in a normoxic environment.

claims.text: Considere que la grasa perirrenal del feto ovino cambia notablemente durante la primera semana posnatal.
claims.quote: Perirenal fat of the ovine foetus undergoes a remarkable phenotypic change during the first week post-birth.
